title: Releases
description: Group changes and publishing into one step that goes live at once, now or at a set time.

empty.title: No releases yet
empty.body: A release collects staged changes and pages to publish, and applies them together.

newDialog.title: New release
newDialog.description: Name it for what goes live together (“Spring launch”). Add items from their editor.
newDialog.name: Title
newDialog.descriptionHint: Optional: what it is for, for the people who review it.

detail.deleteBody: Its entries and staged changes go with it. The items themselves stay as they are.
detail.locked: Scheduled: its entries are locked until it goes live. Unschedule it to change anything.
detail.appliedNote: Applied: everything in it is live. It stays here as history.
detail.previewFailed: The preview could not be opened: {{detail}}
detail.stale: Someone changed this release meanwhile. It now shows their version; try again.

entries.label: Entries
entries.empty: Nothing in this release yet. Open an item and choose “Add to release…”.
entries.rebaseHint: The item was saved since this entry was added. Rebase keeps the staged change and takes the item's current version as its base.

outcome.conflict: The item changed since it was added (now version {{version}}). Rebase it.
outcome.forbidden: You may not do this ({{capability}} needed).

failure.title: The scheduled apply failed
failure.body: Nothing of it went live. Fix the entries below, then schedule or apply it again.

apply.title: Apply “{{title}}” now?
apply.description: Everything below goes live in one step. Nothing goes live if any entry fails.
apply.conflicts: Some entries cannot apply. Nothing went live:

override.hint: As an admin you may apply without the approvals the workflow asks for. The reason is written to the audit log.

scheduleDialog.title: Schedule “{{title}}”
scheduleDialog.description: It goes live at this time. Its items are locked until then; the release is checked first.
scheduleDialog.notReady: The check found problems; fix them first:

share.title: Share preview
share.descriptionRelease: A link that shows the whole site as it will look after this release, without signing in.
share.descriptionItem: A link that shows this item as saved, without signing in.
share.failed: The link could not be made: {{detail}}

add.title: Add to release
add.description: The item goes live with the release, as staged here.
add.noneOpen: No open release yet: name a new one.
add.includeHint: The text and settings as they are in the editor now become the staged change.
add.includeForced: The changes are staged, not saved to the live item.
add.nothing: Choose a status change or include your changes.

editor.changeModeHint: Saving keeps it in the release; nothing goes live until the release is applied.
editor.lockedBy: Locked by the scheduled release “{{title}}”. Unschedule it to change this item.
editor.changeLocked: This release is {{status}}: its staged change cannot be edited.
